candidateModels.name: GERG-2008

identity.parameterSource: published GERG-2008 tables and model files
identity.teqpCompatibility: GERG200X factory exists upstream but is disabled in the PhaseXpert iOS build

candidateModels.implemented: Existing PhaseXpert custom multifluid records already use the relevant GERG binary formulations for CO2+N2, CO2+CH4 and CO2+H2S; no scientifically distinct candidate was added.
candidateModels.independence: Several baseline pair formulations are inherited from GERG-2008, so comparison would not be independent or a new model for those systems.

ratings.densityAccuracy: Marginal across the full evidence map

candidateModels.reason: It is not materially different from the current formulation on key pairs, omits O2 and Ar, and cannot broaden the required target space.

candidateModels.name: EOS-LNG

identity.teqpCompatibility: representable as multifluid but not shipped in the pinned iOS model data

candidateModels.implemented: No; its scope and validation are LNG/methane-rich rather than CO2-rich CCS.
candidateModels.reason: Insufficient target-component coverage and CO2-rich independent validation; extrapolating an LNG formulation would not support the mission.

candidateModels.name: ZMS EOS for CO2-CH4-N2

identity.parameterSource: article plus Fortran code stated available from corresponding author
identity.teqpCompatibility: likely multifluid-compatible; exact code/term identity not verified

candidateModels.implemented: No; the complete referenced Fortran/model package was not publicly retrievable from the article metadata routes, and coefficients were not transcribed or inferred.
candidateModels.independence: The paper reports fitting/reproducing the available binary PVTx/VLE corpus; overlap with PhaseXpert discovery rows must be audited before an independent score.

reportedPerformance.source: author abstract; not a PhaseXpert independent benchmark

candidateModels.reason: Best targeted ternary lead, but exact implementation identity, holdout independence, row-level scoring, stability and iOS performance remain unproved.

candidateModels.name: Xu-Mao-Zheng general Helmholtz CO2-N2-O2-Ar EOS

identity.parameterSource: four binary mixing parameters and generalized Lemmon-Jacobsen departure functions in inaccessible primary tables
identity.teqpCompatibility: structurally plausible but exact representability unverified

candidateModels.implemented: No; lawful acquisition routes yielded metadata but not the complete coefficient tables.
candidateModels.reason: Directly relevant oxyfuel formulation, but missing lawful model data prevents identity-safe implementation or benchmarking.

candidateModels.name: Xu-Mao H2-CH4-C2H6-C3H8-CO2-N2 Helmholtz EOS

identity.parameterSource: new closed-access primary article; complete coefficients not lawfully accessible in this audit

candidateModels.implemented: No; publication metadata were available but exact parameters and code were not.
candidateModels.reason: Most relevant newly published H2-containing lead, but too new and insufficiently accessible for an identity-safe independent bake-off.

candidateModels.name: CoolProp 8.0.0 HEOS shipped multifluid database

identity.representation: existing PhaseXpert General Properties native XCFramework

candidateModels.implemented: Already diagnostic/production-limited in General Properties; it was not treated as experimental truth or exposed as a new Advanced model.
candidateModels.vleEvidence: No same-state independent candidate VLE matrix establishes broader production capability.

ratings.densityAccuracy: Poor globally; good only on existing narrow CH4/H2/O2 slices
ratings.independentEvidence: Strong for the scored density rows

candidateModels.reason: It does not materially outperform EOS-CG, has catastrophic local root/phase errors, and is a database implementation rather than one traceable alternative formulation across all target pairs.

candidateModels.name: UMR-PRU

identity.family: Peng-Robinson plus UNIFAC-derived universal mixing rule

candidateModels.independence: The Petropoulou CO2/CH4 implementation reported in the experimental paper was fitted to those isotherms, making that evidence circular for this bake-off.
candidateModels.reason: No complete untuned target-pair parameter matrix or independent broad CCS holdout was established.

candidateModels.name: PC-SAFT / CPA / SAFT-VR Mie families

identity.parameterSource: model-specific pure and binary/group parameter sets

candidateModels.implemented: No; teqp factories are excluded from the current iOS build and no single published untuned parameter set covering all target pairs was found.

ratings.densityAccuracy: Unavailable on a common untuned matrix
ratings.vleAccuracy: Unavailable on a common untuned matrix

candidateModels.reason: Published applications rely on fitted binary/group parameters; assembling or zeroing missing interactions would violate the no-fitting/no-invention rules.

datasetIndex.use: candidate discrimination only; no alternative implemented

runtime.baselineDensity: existing provider tests remain interactive; no new candidate density binary was added
runtime.coolPropCandidate: already shipped; no new binary, construction cache, allocation, or XCFramework size impact
runtime.unimplementedCandidates: runtime cannot be honestly benchmarked without exact model implementations

rejectedDomains: all proposed continuous binary density domains
productionDecision.reason: No identity-complete, untuned, independently benchmarkable, iOS-feasible alternative materially beats EOS-CG over a broader connected evidence domain. ZMS/Xu-Mao formulations are the strongest research leads but require lawful exact model packages and independent holdout audits.
